subject: Game Theory
title: Deadlines and Time Pressure
description: A short lesson to help you apply Deadlines and Time Pressure.

hook.text: In 2013, Congress nearly defaulted on US debt. Last-minute negotiations produced a deal at 11:57 PM.

buildup.text: Deadlines force action. Without them, both sides wait, hoping the other will concede first.

discovery.text: The side that fears missing the deadline more will make larger concessions as time runs out.

twist.text: Artificial deadlines can backfire. If the other side knows your deadline is fake, they ignore the pressure.

climax.text: Real deadlines—contract expirations, court dates, market windows—create genuine urgency that shifts power.

punchline.text: The clock negotiates for whoever fears it less.

quiz.question: Who benefits most from a deadline?
options: The side that set the deadline
The side less affected by missing it
